brief_summary: Three-panel strip of stem silhouettes. Left: Cherry MX2A Silent Black with TPE pads drawn as bands fused to the rail tops and leg feet in the dusty-rose splash, plus a travel bar showing 3.7 mm total and 1.9 mm pre-travel against a 4.0 mm standard. Centre: Gazzew Boba U4 with separate silicone pads seated on the same two surfaces with a hairline gap, annotated as removable and as setting the stem's rest position. Right: Gazzew Boba U4T with both pad seats drawn as dashed ghosts and a full 4.0 mm travel bar — the control.
